name: Inkscape
description_en:
Inkscape is a free desktop vector editor whose native document format is SVG. It is suited to illustrations, diagrams, icons, lettering and scalable design elements, with path editing, shapes, text, layers, tracing and export tools. Imported photographs can be part of a drawing, but vector editing is a different workflow from pixel-level retouching.

The official stable release read is 1.4.4. Keep the editable SVG, inspect the actual export in its destination and check dependencies such as fonts, linked images and extensions. A supported file extension does not guarantee an unchanged round-trip to another editor, and platform/version-specific issues matter for automation.
description_zh:
Inkscape是以SVG为原生格式的免费桌面矢量编辑器，适合插画、图表、图标、文字造型及可缩放设计元素，提供路径、形状、文字、图层、描摹及导出工具。图稿可包含照片，但矢量编辑与像素级修图是不同流程。

实读官方稳定版为1.4.4。应保留可编辑SVG，在目标软件检查实际输出，并核对字体、链接图片及扩展等依赖。支持某扩展名不保证其他编辑器无损往返，自动化也需考虑平台/版本问题。

core_features.explanation_en: Draw shapes, edit nodes, apply fills/strokes and use path operations for scalable compositions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可绘制形状、编辑节点、设置填充/描边并执行路径操作，构建可缩放图稿。

core_features.explanation_en: Use text, groups, layers, alignment and stacking controls to compose a reusable design.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过文字、组、图层、对齐及堆叠控制组织可复用设计。

core_features.explanation_en: Official release documentation describes raster/vector and batch export; exact formats can depend on extensions and platform.
core_features.explanation_zh: 官方发布文档描述位图/矢量及批量导出，确切格式可能受扩展和平台影响。

sections.title_en: Build an editable diagram from shapes and text
sections.title_zh: 通过形状及文字构建可编辑图表
sections.en:
For an illustrative process diagram, create a new document, draw the step shapes and enter labels. Use the Selector for numeric position/size, group related objects and use Align and Distribute for consistent spacing. The basic tutorial distinguishes the fill, stroke color and stroke style controls, and explains object stacking. Save the SVG before producing a delivery file; the tutorial recommends regular saving despite autosave. This exercise was read, not performed.

The features page adds node editing, Boolean operations, live path effects, bitmap tracing, clones/symbols and text on paths. Choose a small set of those tools for the actual design instead of assuming automatic tracing produces a finished logo. Check small-scale legibility, curve quality and whether text remains editable after handoff.
sections.zh:
例如流程图，可新建文档、绘制步骤形状并输入标签，用Selector设置数值位置/尺寸、将关联对象分组，以Align and Distribute统一间距。基础教程区分填充、描边颜色和描边样式，并解释对象堆叠；交付前先存SVG，教程建议即使有自动保存也应定期保存。上述练习仅阅读，未执行。

功能页另列节点编辑、布尔操作、实时路径效果、位图描摹、克隆/符号及沿路径文字。应为实际设计选合适工具，不能假定自动描摹就生成完工logo；交接需检查小尺寸可读性、曲线及文字可编辑性。

sections.title_en: Preserve SVG while validating the delivery format
sections.en:
The old FAQ still says bitmap export is PNG only, but the official 1.2 release notes describe the redesigned general Export dialog with PNG, JPEG, Web P, TIFF, SVG and PDF and batch export for objects, layers, pages, formats and resolutions. This record uses that release evidence to avoid repeating the outdated restriction; it does not assume every extension format is installed or working on every machine.

Keep an editable SVG and inspect the exported PDF/image in the intended viewer. SVG support and editor-specific features vary; fonts, embedded/linked images, filters and text should be checked with representative files. A raster export does not preserve editable vector objects, and converting text to paths changes its editing/search behavior. Do not treat an exported PDF as a complete source-project backup.
sections.zh:
旧FAQ仍称位图仅能导出PNG，但官方1.2发布说明描述新版通用Export对话框支持PNG、JPEG、WebP、TIFF、SVG、PDF，并可按对象、图层、页面、格式及分辨率批量导出。本记录用发布证据避免重复旧限制，也不假定所有机器已安装并能运行每种扩展格式。

应保留可编辑SVG，在目标查看器检查PDF/图像。SVG支持和编辑器专有能力不同，字体、嵌入/链接图片、滤镜及文字需用代表文件核对。位图输出不保留可编辑矢量对象，文字转路径也会改变编辑/搜索行为，PDF导出不能当作完整源项目备份。

sections.title_en: Check the actual release and platform for file compatibility
sections.title_zh: 按实际版本和平台检查文件兼容
sections.en:
The stable release page lists 1.4.4 dated May 6, 2026 for GNU/Linux, Windows and macOS. It describes 1.4.3/1.4.4 as bridge releases for the planned 1.5 multipage format; versions below 1.4.3 cannot interpret pages created in the new 1.5 format. Check the collaborating editor’s version before exchanging multipage files, and retain an original before any conversion. This is a documented forward-compatibility issue, not evidence that 1.5 is the current stable release.

The same page warns that official macOS DMGbuilds started from the command line cannot run extensions, including affected Python-based import/export formats, as part of a security change. It also lists Wayland/Gtkdialog issues. A cross-platform feature list therefore cannot guarantee a particular command-line export pipeline. These known issues were read, not reproduced or bypassed.
sections.zh:
稳定版页列1.4.4，日期2026年5月6日，支持GNU/Linux、Windows及macOS，并描述1.4.3/1.4.4为计划中1.5多页格式的桥接版本；低于1.4.3不能解释新1.5格式页面。交换多页文件前需核对协作者版本，转换前保留原件。这是文档中的前向兼容问题，不表示1.5已是当前稳定版。

同页提醒官方macOS DMG因安全变更，从命令行启动时扩展不能工作，包括部分Python导入/导出格式，并列Wayland/Gtk对话框问题。因此跨平台功能清单不能保证特定命令行导出流水线。本次只读取已知问题，未复现或绕过。

sections.title_en: Distinguish vector composition from animation and prepress
sections.title_zh: 区分矢量排版、动画及印前工作
sections.en:
Inkscape can include bitmap objects and tracing, while the FAQ explains that photographs/pixel work and vectors solve different tasks. It also distinguishes drawing assets for animation from an animation timeline inside the editor. A diagram or logo workflow should not be expanded into a promise of a full video-production environment.

The features/tutorial pages show CMYK color-selection controls, but that alone does not prove a complete CMYK print pipeline. The FAQ contains old release references, and the historical 1.2 notes list additional extension export routes. Confirm the chosen printer’s profiles, separations, PDF requirements and the exact working extension/toolchain with a proof. Neither color accuracy, proprietary-file round-trip nor a specific plotter/CNCdevice was tested here.
sections.zh:
Inkscape可包含位图对象和描摹，但FAQ解释照片/像素工作与矢量各解决不同任务，也区分为动画绘制资产和编辑器内动画时间线，不能将图表/logo流程扩大为完整视频制作承诺。

功能/教程页展示CMYK颜色选择控制，但本身不能证明完整CMYK印刷流水线。FAQ含旧版描述，历史1.2说明则列额外扩展导出方式。需以实际打样确认印厂配置文件、分色、PDF要求及确切可用扩展/工具链。本次未测试色准、专有格式往返或特定绘图仪/CNC设备。

sections.title_en: Keep artwork rights separate from the GPL application
sections.title_zh: 区分作品权利及GPL应用许可
sections.en:
The official site presents Inkscape as free/open-source software. Its licensing page displays GPL version 2 for the software and separately says saved/exported artwork belongs to its creators or the relevant original authors. Using the program does not make third-party assets public domain or require an artist’s original file to use the application’s license. Fonts, images, templates and derivatives still need their applicable rights checked. The exact notice for a redistributed build should be read rather than inferring all later-version rights from a generic license clause.

No mandatory software subscription was established. Hardware, training, fonts, stock assets, custom extensions and professional help remain possible costs. Inkscape fits users who need local editable SVG/vector work and can validate their handoff. Teams requiring a guaranteed proprietary application round-trip, collaboration service or contractual support should obtain/test those separately. No program, extension, design, export, print or conversion was run.
sections.zh:
官网将Inkscape标为免费开源，许可页显示软件GPL第2版，并另述保存/导出作品属于创作者或相关原作者。使用程序不会让第三方资产成为公有领域，也不要求艺术家原创文件采用应用许可；字体、图片、模板及衍生仍需核对适用权利。再分发具体构建应读取其确切声明，不能从通用许可条款推断全部后续版本权利。

本次未建立强制软件订阅，硬件、培训、字体、素材、定制扩展及专业协助仍可能收费。需本地可编辑SVG/矢量工作且能验证交接的用户可考虑；如需保证专有应用往返、协作服务或合同支持，应另取证/测试。本次未运行程序、扩展、设计、导出、印刷或转换。
